title: 首领：三视图、动作表、分部件拆图、首领专属动作条与登场插画

subject.zh: 翼展约四米的巨鸦，羽毛焦黑带暗紫光泽（#141418、#3a3a44），喙与爪是旧银色，眼睛暗红，颈羽间缠着几枚闪亮的金色小物（#c8a24a）。振翼阶段羽毛炸开、不断落灰；力竭时黑灰剥落，羽根露出银色（#c0c8d0）。
subject.en: A giant raven with a wingspan of about four meters, scorched black feathers with a dark purple sheen (#141418, #3a3a44), old-silver beak and talons, dull red eyes, a few shiny gold trinkets (#c8a24a) tangled in its neck feathers. In the wing-beat phase its feathers flare and shed ash; when exhausted the black ash peels away and silver feather roots (#c0c8d0) show.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写头部：暗红的眼、旧银色的喙与颈羽间的金色小物。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the head: dull red eye, old-silver beak and the gold trinkets in the neck feathers.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。飞行首领。第三阶段的狂暴只用色样行加深眼色，不另出图；黑灰剥落、露出银色羽根的样子只画在倒地帧的末两帧。金色小物只占几个像素，不要画成项链。

subject.zh: 约五米高的人形巨物，由灰、碎石与澱晶裹成，石块之间渗着暗紫的澱（#4a3a62），肩背插着淡蓝白的晶簇（#b8c4d0），双拳是粗大的石块，胸口嵌着一块纹样磨平的古石板。裂解阶段表面结出灰壳；崩解阶段胸口裂开，露出发微光的澱核。
subject.en: A humanoid giant about five meters tall, packed from ash, rubble and dian crystal, dark purple dian (#4a3a62) seeping between the stones, pale blue-white crystal clusters (#b8c4d0) jutting from its shoulders and back, fists of massive boulders, an old stone slab with worn-away carvings set in its chest. In the splitting phase an ash shell crusts over its surface; in the collapse phase the chest cracks open and a faintly glowing dian core shows.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写胸口：纹样磨平的古石板，以及石板后面的澱核。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the chest: the worn stone slab and the dian core behind it.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。超大首领，走分部件拆图。灰壳阶段用色样行把石块调灰提亮；崩解阶段由导入工具隐藏胸口石板部件，露出单独的澱核部件；死亡时部件散落成石块。

Parts: torso (with the chest slab), head, left and right upper arms, left and right forearms with fists, left and right thighs, left and right shins with feet, two shoulder crystal clusters, and the dian core as its own piece. subject.zh: 体长约四米的巨型多足甲虫，贴地爬行，铁灰甲壳（#6a6f7a、#2a2d33）分成层层环节，背上密生淡蓝到冰白的澱晶簇（#9fb4c8、#d9e4ef），十二条短足，头前一对掘土的宽颚。躲晶时缩成一团，只露晶背；受伤越重晶簇越亮。
subject.en: A giant many-legged beetle about four meters long that crawls low to the ground, iron-gray carapace (#6a6f7a, #2a2d33) in layered segments, dense clusters of pale blue to ice-white dian crystal (#9fb4c8, #d9e4ef) on its back, twelve short legs, a pair of broad digging mandibles at the front. When it hides it curls into a ball showing only the crystal back; the more hurt it is, the brighter the clusters.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写头部的宽颚与背上的晶簇根部。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the broad mandibles and the base of the back crystals.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。多足首领，腿数每帧固定为十二条。躲晶姿态画在第 5 行特殊技的前 3 帧（缩成一团），第 4 到 8 帧是起身甩落晶块。

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。整张图只画第一阶段的常态外形，后续阶段的变化不画进来。多足首领：腿的数量在每一帧保持一致，爬行时按波浪交替起落，身体贴地，绝不画成四足兽。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces away from the viewer (up), showing the back. Draw only the first-phase normal form in this sheet; leave out the changes of later phases. Many-legged boss: the same number of legs in every frame, legs rising and falling in a wave as it crawls, body low to the ground, never drawn as a four-legged beast.

items.notes: 多足首领，腿数每帧固定为十二条。躲晶姿态画在第 5 行特殊技的前 3 帧（缩成一团），第 4 到 8 帧是起身甩落晶块。附三视图作参照，三个朝向的配色与辨识特征一致。

subject.zh: 体长约四米的巨型多足甲虫，贴地爬行，铁灰甲壳（#6a6f7a、#2a2d33）分成层层环节，背上密生淡蓝到冰白的澱晶簇（#9fb4c8、#d9e4ef），十二条短足，头前一对掘土的宽颚。躲晶时缩成一团，只露晶背；受伤越重晶簇越亮。
subject.en: A giant many-legged beetle about four meters long that crawls low to the ground, iron-gray carapace (#6a6f7a, #2a2d33) in layered segments, dense clusters of pale blue to ice-white dian crystal (#9fb4c8, #d9e4ef) on its back, twelve short legs, a pair of broad digging mandibles at the front. When it hides it curls into a ball showing only the crystal back; the more hurt it is, the brighter the clusters.

extra.zh: 画它半立起前身、宽颚张开，背上的晶簇发亮。
extra.en: Show it rearing its front half, mandibles open, the back crystals shining.

subject.zh: 三十九岁的人族匪首，粗壮精悍，晒黑的方脸，右眼戴黑皮眼罩，左眼是凶狠的灰褐色，下巴满是胡茬，深棕短发剃得很短。锈褐色钉甲 #6a4a32 外披破旧灰斗篷 #5a5a52，腰缠粗皮带，右手一把单手劈斧，斧背沾着灰。狠，但讲规矩。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-nine-year-old human bandit chief, thickset and hard: a sunburnt square face, a black leather patch over his right eye, a fierce grey-brown left eye, heavy stubble, dark brown hair cropped short. Rust-brown studded brigandine #6a4a32 under a ragged grey cloak #5a5a52, a thick leather belt, a one-handed cleaver axe in his right hand, ash on its back edge. Ruthless but bound by his own rules. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。特殊技重劈：双手抡起砍刀、身体后仰蓄力，第 2 帧砍刀重重劈落到地面，第 3 帧刀身陷地，第 4 帧拔刀复位。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Special move, heavy chop: he swings the cleaver up with both hands and leans back to gather force, frame 2 the cleaver slams into the ground, frame 3 the blade is stuck in the earth, frame 4 he wrenches it free and recovers.

subject.zh: 上百只灰褐澱鼠（#5e544a、#3a332c）的身体与尾巴缠结成的一头巨鼠，约两米半长，轮廓上不断有小鼠头探出又缩回，几十条粉灰色的长尾（#c9a9a0）拖在身后像一束湿绳，一对浑浊的灰眼。被打散时身体崩成鼠群，在水里重新聚拢。
subject.en: A giant rat about two and a half meters long, knotted together from the bodies and tails of a hundred gray-brown dian rats (#5e544a, #3a332c), small rat heads poking out of its outline and pulling back in, dozens of long pinkish-gray tails (#c9a9a0) dragging behind like a bundle of wet rope, a pair of cloudy gray eyes. When broken apart it collapses into a swarm of rats that regathers in the water.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写身体表面：缠在一起的小鼠头、鼠爪与尾巴。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the body surface: tangled little rat heads, paws and tails.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。巨鼠的整体剪影要稳定，表面小鼠头的位置每帧可以变。倒地帧画成散成一地小鼠后不动。

subject.zh: 约四米高的闸门傀儡，旧时工匠用铆接铁板与橡木闸叶造成，满身铁锈（#8a4a2a、#5a3a2a）与水苔（#4a5a3a），双臂是两扇可以横扫的闸臂，腰间缠着断掉的闸绳与铁链；锈壳下藏着一颗黄铜核心（#c8a04a），放水后才在腹部露出。
subject.en: A sluice-gate golem about four meters tall, built long ago by craftsmen from riveted iron plates and oak gate leaves, covered in rust (#8a4a2a, #5a3a2a) and water moss (#4a5a3a), both arms are swinging gate leaves, broken sluice ropes and chains wound around its waist; under the rust shell hides a brass core (#c8a04a) that only shows in its belly once the water is drained.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写腹部：锈壳的铆钉与缝隙里的黄铜核心。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the belly: the riveted rust shell and the brass core in its seam.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。常态画锈壳合上的样子；核心露出的样子画在第 5 行特殊技（闸臂张开、腹部敞开）。不要画成人形骑士，它是闸门造的机械。

subject.zh: 不肯死去的老祭司亡灵，枯瘦的骨架挂着焦黄发黑的旧式白袍，袍边绣着褪色的金色光纹（#d8c27a），兜帽下是半张干枯的脸，一手捧着烧剩一半的祷书，一手举着燃着白焰的长柄香炉。引导焚年时香炉火焰高涨，袍角冒出火星。
subject.en: The undead ghost of an old priest who refuses to die, a gaunt frame hung with a scorched yellow-black robe of an old white style, faded gold light-patterns (#d8c27a) along its hem, half a withered face under the hood, one hand holding a half-burnt prayer book, the other raising a long-handled censer burning with white flame. While channeling it the censer flame surges and sparks rise from the robe hem.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写半张干枯的脸、兜帽边与长柄香炉。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the half-withered face, the hood edge and the long-handled censer.

subject.zh: 体长约五米的巨蜈，深蓝灰的甲节（#3c4a58、#12171c），脊背沿中线长着一排冰蓝到近白的澱晶刺（#7fa6c6、#d6ecff），每节一对足，头上一对弯钳与短触须，尾节翘起像晶刺的弩。碎晶阶段晶刺炸成残桩，甲节缝里透出光。
subject.en: A giant centipede about five meters long, deep blue-gray segments (#3c4a58, #12171c), a row of ice-blue to near-white dian crystal spikes (#7fa6c6, #d6ecff) along the middle of its back, one pair of legs per segment, curved pincers and short antennae on the head, the tail segment raised like a crystal crossbow. In the shattered phase the spikes burst into stumps and light shows through the seams.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写头部的弯钳与一节带晶刺的背甲。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the curved pincers and one spiked back segment.

subject.zh: 从古门框里涌出的澱凝成的门形巨兽，约四米高，身躯像一扇竖起的厚重石门板（#6e7270、#2a2a34），门缝里透出暗紫的光（#4a3a62），四肢粗短如门柱，没有头，门楣处一道横裂当作嘴；身上嵌着五块可以击碎的门形澱板（#5a3a48）。
subject.en: A door-shaped beast about four meters tall, congealed from the dian pouring out of an ancient door frame, its body like a heavy upright stone door slab (#6e7270, #2a2a34), dark purple light (#4a3a62) leaking from the door crack, limbs short and thick as door posts, no head, a horizontal split under the lintel serving as a mouth; five breakable door-shaped dian plates (#5a3a48) set into its body.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写一块门形澱板与门缝里的暗紫光。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of one door-shaped dian plate and the purple light in the crack.

subject.zh: 从河底翻起的巨鲶，体长十米以上，滑腻的青黑色皮（#2a3a3a、#1a2224），腹部灰白，皮上嵌着发光的澱晶碎片，宽口两侧垂着四根粗如船缆的长须，小眼浑浊发白。扑击时半身跃出水面，口能塞进一条驳船。
subject.en: A giant catfish heaving up from the riverbed, over ten meters long, slick blue-black skin (#2a3a3a, #1a2224) with a gray-white belly, glowing dian crystal shards embedded in its hide, four barbels thick as mooring ropes hanging from the corners of its wide mouth, small cloudy white eyes. When it lunges half its body leaps out of the water and its mouth could swallow a barge.

extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the wide mouth, the barbels and the crystal shards in its hide.

subject.zh: 从河底翻起的巨鲶，体长十米以上，滑腻的青黑色皮（#2a3a3a、#1a2224），腹部灰白，皮上嵌着发光的澱晶碎片，宽口两侧垂着四根粗如船缆的长须，小眼浑浊发白。扑击时半身跃出水面，口能塞进一条驳船。
subject.en: A giant catfish heaving up from the riverbed, over ten meters long, slick blue-black skin (#2a3a3a, #1a2224) with a gray-white belly, glowing dian crystal shards embedded in its hide, four barbels thick as mooring ropes hanging from the corners of its wide mouth, small cloudy white eyes. subject.zh: 冻在冰里多年的守军队长骸骨，骨头覆着一层白霜，眼眶里是冰蓝的冷光（#9ab4d0）；穿几十年前的北境冬装与锁甲，残破的毛领披风冻成硬块，头戴凹陷的铁盔，双手持一柄长矛，矛尖挂着冰凌。
subject.en: The skeleton of a garrison captain frozen in ice for years, bones coated in white frost, cold ice-blue light (#9ab4d0) in the eye sockets; northern winter gear and mail from decades ago, a ragged fur-collared cloak frozen stiff, a dented iron helm, a long spear in both hands with icicles hanging from its tip.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写铁盔下的冰蓝眼光与矛尖的冰凌。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the ice-blue eyes under the helm and the icicles on the spear tip.

subject.zh: 冻河上空盘旋的冬风之形，一团灰白风雪卷成的漏斗（#d8e8f4、#7aa0c4、#4a5a6a），中段有一张宽大的空洞喉口，口沿挂满冰凌与碎骨，风里裹着细小的霜刃；没有四肢，底部像冰雾一样拖在地面。冬风灌喉时喉口张到最大，全身向内收紧。
subject.en: The shape of a winter wind circling over a frozen river, a funnel of gray-white snow and wind (#d8e8f4, #7aa0c4, #4a5a6a), a wide hollow throat in its middle with icicles and bone shards around the rim, tiny frost blades caught in the wind; no limbs, its base trailing along the ground like ice fog. When the wind pours into its throat the mouth opens widest and its whole body pulls inward.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写喉口：口沿的冰凌与碎骨。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the throat: the icicles and bone shards around the rim.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。无定形首领，有明确正面（喉口朝向），所以出三个朝向。风雪画成不透明的实色块，霜刃粒子由特效层画。

subject.zh: 坑底冰中立起的一尊圣像，苍白瓷质的修长人形（#ede8dc、#9db4c8），面容平静对称，双臂张开托着一圈几何形的冰晶光环，衣褶像瓷器一样光滑，伤口不流血而是结出晶面；脚下与冰面连成一体，缓缓滑行。瓷壳阶段全身覆上一层更厚的白瓷。
subject.en: A saint statue risen from the ice at the bottom of a pit, a tall slender figure of pale porcelain (#ede8dc, #9db4c8), a calm symmetrical face, arms spread holding up a geometric ring of ice crystal, robe folds smooth as porcelain, wounds that crystallize into facets instead of bleeding; its feet are fused with the ice and it glides slowly. In the porcelain-shell phase a thicker layer of white porcelain covers it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写对称的瓷面与几何形冰晶光环。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the symmetrical porcelain face and the geometric ice ring.

subject.en: A saint statue risen from the ice at the bottom of a pit, a tall slender figure of pale porcelain (#ede8dc, #9db4c8), a calm symmetrical face, arms spread holding up a geometric ring of ice crystal, robe folds smooth as porcelain, wounds that crystallize into facets instead of bleeding; its feet are fused with the ice and it glides slowly. In the porcelain-shell phase a thicker layer of white porcelain covers it.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。整张图只画第一阶段的常态外形，后续阶段的变化不画进来。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces away from the viewer (up), showing the back. Draw only the first-phase normal form in this sheet; leave out the changes of later phases.

subject.zh: 由千百具无名死者的骸骨堆叠成的巨大骨人，约五米高，佝偻前行；骨色灰白发黄（#d8d0bc、#9c947e），骨缝里结着灰与淡紫晶（#c6b5e0），胸腔是空的门形洞口，手臂由成串的肋骨拧成，背上挂着残破的古衣与器物。碎成三堆后各自往回爬。
subject.en: A giant bone figure about five meters tall heaped together from the skeletons of countless nameless dead, walking hunched; bones of yellowed gray-white (#d8d0bc, #9c947e), ash and pale purple crystal (#c6b5e0) crusted in the joints, an empty door-shaped hole for a chest, arms twisted from strings of ribs, ragged ancient clothes and household things hanging from its back. Broken into three heaps, each crawls back toward the others.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写胸腔的门形空洞与骨缝里的淡紫晶。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the door-shaped hole in its chest and the purple crystal in the joints.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。碎成三堆的状态画在第 5 行特殊技（崩散成三堆再聚拢）。千骨行者幼体（魔物类）是同一造型的小号精英，以本条三视图为参照。

subject.zh: 潜在灰沙下的巨蠕，体长二十米以上，背脊像一列灰色岩岛浮出，覆着鳞片般的灰岩甲（#6e6054、#45403e），鳞缝里长着淡紫晶簇；头部是没有眼睛的圆钝吻端，张开时露出一圈圈向内的尖齿。吸沙时口部张成漏斗，翻身时露出灰白的腹面。
subject.en: A giant worm lurking under the ash sand, over twenty meters long, its back surfacing like a line of gray rock islands, covered in scale-like plates of gray rock (#6e6054, #45403e) with pale purple crystal clusters in the seams; an eyeless blunt round snout that opens to ring after ring of inward-pointing teeth. When it sucks in sand its mouth opens into a funnel; when it rolls over it shows a gray-white belly.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写张开的口：一圈圈向内的尖齿。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the open mouth: rings of inward-pointing teeth.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。超长首领，走分部件拆图；露出沙面以下的部分不画，沙面由渲染层画。玩家可能站在它背上，背脊三段要像可以落脚的岩岛。

subject.zh: 门站残墟的古代守卫澱像，约三米高，石与青铜的铠甲之形，铠甲里是空的，只有暗紫的雾在关节间流动（#4a3a62）；头盔面甲是一道竖直的门形缝隙，透出灰白冷光，手持刻着拱门纹样的大盾与一柄长戟，铜锈斑驳（#5a6a4a、#8a7448）。
subject.en: An ancient guardian construct of a ruined gate station, about three meters tall, a suit of stone and bronze armor that is empty inside, only dark purple mist (#4a3a62) flowing between the joints; its visor is a vertical door-shaped slit glowing cold gray-white, it holds a great shield carved with an arch pattern and a long halberd, mottled with verdigris (#5a6a4a, #8a7448).

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写门形面甲缝隙与盾面的拱门纹样。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the door-shaped visor slit and the arch carving on the shield.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。铠甲里面是空的，关节缝里只能看到暗紫的雾，不要画出骨头或肉。

subject.zh: 门站残墟的古代守卫澱像，约三米高，石与青铜的铠甲之形，铠甲里是空的，只有暗紫的雾在关节间流动（#4a3a62）；头盔面甲是一道竖直的门形缝隙，透出灰白冷光，手持刻着拱门纹样的大盾与一柄长戟，铜锈斑驳（#5a6a4a、#8a7448）。
subject.en: An ancient guardian construct of a ruined gate station, about three meters tall, a suit of stone and bronze armor that is empty inside, only dark purple mist (#4a3a62) flowing between the joints; its visor is a vertical door-shaped slit glowing cold gray-white, it holds a great shield carved with an arch pattern and a long halberd, mottled with verdigris (#5a6a4a, #8a7448).

extra.zh: 画它横戟挡路、盾面立起，面甲缝隙里的冷光直视画面。
extra.en: Show it barring the way with its halberd, shield raised, the cold light in its visor slit staring out at the viewer.

subject.zh: 千年前的老妇亡灵，佝偻矮小，灰烬色的皮肤与头巾（#8a8580），穿古老样式的家常长裙与围裙，围裙口袋里塞满铜门牌，腰间串着十几块叮当作响的门牌，一只手总是半举着像在敲门。叫名时她伸长脖子、张开没牙的嘴；最后阶段眼窝亮起两点淡紫的光。
subject.en: The ghost of an old woman from a thousand years ago, small and hunched, ash-colored skin and headscarf (#8a8580), an old-fashioned house dress and apron, the apron pockets stuffed with copper doorplates, a dozen clinking doorplates strung at her waist, one hand always half raised as if to knock. When calling a name she stretches her neck and opens her toothless mouth; in the last phase two points of pale purple light kindle in her eye sockets.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写腰间的一串铜门牌与半举敲门的手。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the string of copper doorplates and her half-raised knocking hand.

subject.zh: 从书架间漫出的一大团活墨，约三米宽，表面像湿亮的黑墨水（#2b2b3a），浮着一行行淡黄的文字样纹路（#d8d2c0）在缓慢流动，前端隆起成一个似人非人的上半身，伸出几条墨手；被书架回墨时墨面泛起淡紫（#7a6a9a）的涟漪。
subject.en: A great mass of living ink spilling out from between bookshelves, about three meters wide, its surface like wet glossy black ink (#2b2b3a) with lines of pale yellow script-like patterns (#d8d2c0) slowly drifting across it, its front rising into a half-human upper body that reaches out several ink hands; when the shelves feed ink back into it, pale purple (#7a6a9a) ripples spread over its surface.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写墨面上流动的文字样纹路与一只墨手。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the script-like patterns flowing on the ink and one ink hand.

subject.zh: 黑铁矿层里的巨型掘穴兽，体长约五米，形如没有眼睛的巨鼹与蠕虫之间，钝圆的身体覆着啃来的黑铁片（#3a3e44、#5a6268），每啃一处铁甲就厚一层；最醒目的是一张由三瓣黑铁齿颚组成的巨口，张开时像绽开的铁花。钻地时只露背甲。
subject.en: A giant burrowing beast of the black-iron seam, about five meters long, shaped between an eyeless giant mole and a worm, its blunt round body armored with gnawed black iron plates (#3a3e44, #5a6268) that thicken with every seam it chews; most striking is a huge mouth of three black-iron jaw petals that opens like a blooming iron flower. When it burrows only its back plates show.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写三瓣黑铁齿颚张开的样子。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the three black-iron jaw petals opening.

subject.zh: 晶洞腔里一颗会呼吸的巨大晶洞，约四米高的圆鼓岩壳（#4a3e36、#6a5a4e），壳上裂开一道竖口，里面密排紫白的晶簇（#c6b5e0、#e8e0f0），像肺一样一张一缩；底部长出几条岩石短足支撑挪动。闭洞时岩壳合拢；最后阶段壳面开裂，碎晶簌簌落下。
subject.en: A giant breathing geode in a crystal cavern, a round bulging rock shell about four meters tall (#4a3e36, #6a5a4e) split by a vertical opening packed with purple-white crystal clusters (#c6b5e0, #e8e0f0) that swell and shrink like a lung; a few short stone legs underneath carry it along. When it closes the shell seals shut; in the last phase the shell cracks and crystal shards trickle down.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写竖口里密排的紫白晶簇。

subject.en: A giant breathing geode in a crystal cavern, a round bulging rock shell about four meters tall (#4a3e36, #6a5a4e) split by a vertical opening packed with purple-white crystal clusters (#c6b5e0, #e8e0f0) that swell and shrink like a lung; a few short stone legs underneath carry it along. subject.zh: 以一扇没有墙的旧木门框为中心，十几个灰烬色的人影（#8a8580、#4d4a52）挤在门框两侧倚门张望，穿千年前的家常衣服，有老人、妇人和抱孩子的人，脸都朝着同一个方向；整团一起挪动。开门阶段门框里涌出暗紫的澱（#4a3a62）。
subject.en: Centered on an old wooden door frame with no wall around it, a dozen ash-colored figures (#8a8580, #4d4a52) crowd on both sides leaning on the frame and looking out, in household clothes from a thousand years ago, old people, women and people carrying children, all their faces turned the same way; the whole group moves together. In the opening phase dark purple dian (#4a3a62) pours out of the door frame.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写倚在门框上的两三个人影：一位抱孩子的妇人和一位老人。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of two or three figures leaning on the frame: a woman holding a child and an old man.

subject.zh: 从灰烬室里漂出的大批焦页卷成的纸卷风暴，约三米高，像一条立起的长卷在空中缓缓旋转，层层焦黄与灰黑的纸页（#d8d0c4、#45403e）边缘闪着暗红火星（#ff9a4a），纸面上留着一行行模糊的黑色划痕。焚卷阶段整卷绷直，中心亮起火光。
subject.en: A paper storm rolled up from a great drift of scorched pages blown out of an ash chamber, about three meters tall, like an upright scroll turning slowly in the air, layer on layer of scorched yellow and gray-black pages (#d8d0c4, #45403e) with dark red sparks (#ff9a4a) along their edges, rows of blurred black scratches on the paper. In the burning phase the whole scroll pulls taut and fire lights its center.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写几张焦页的边缘火星与模糊划痕。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of a few scorched pages with sparks on the edges and blurred scratches.

subject.en: A storm heart condensed from a standing pillar of ash, a gray-white whirlwind about six meters tall (#b9b4a8, #6e6054), a glowing dark red core of molten glass (#8a3a24, #ff9a4a) hanging in the eye, shards of glass, splintered door-frame wood and pale purple crystal grit caught in its walls; in the melting phase the glass core stretches into a door shape.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写风眼里的熔化玻璃核与风墙里的碎玻璃。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the molten glass core in the eye and the glass shards in the wind wall.

subject.en: A storm heart condensed from a standing pillar of ash, a gray-white whirlwind about six meters tall (#b9b4a8, #6e6054), a glowing dark red core of molten glass (#8a3a24, #ff9a4a) hanging in the eye, shards of glass, splintered door-frame wood and pale purple crystal grit caught in its walls; in the melting phase the glass core stretches into a door shape.

extra.zh: 画风眼正中的玻璃核拉长成门形、碎玻璃在四周飞旋。
extra.en: Show the glass core in the eye stretched into a door shape with glass shards whirling around it.

subject.zh: 霜骨亡灵从冰下聚成的巨人，约十米高，由冻在一起的骸骨与冰块堆成（#d8e8f4、#9ab4c8、#9c947e），胸腔里挂着一口布满冰凌的古铜钟（#8a7448），钟摆是一具小小的骸骨；头部是一大团骨与冰，眼窝里是冰蓝冷光。半身沉进冰河后只露胸以上。
subject.en: A giant gathered from frost-bone dead under the ice, about ten meters tall, heaped from skeletons and blocks of ice frozen together (#d8e8f4, #9ab4c8, #9c947e), an old bronze bell (#8a7448) crusted with icicles hanging inside its rib cage, a small skeleton for the clapper; its head a great lump of bone and ice with ice-blue light in the sockets. Sunk to the waist in the frozen river, only its chest and above show.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写胸腔里的冰钟与骸骨钟摆。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the ice-crusted bell and the skeleton clapper inside the rib cage.

subject.zh: 被割了舌头的遗民敲钟人，瘦高，三十来岁，灰褐的旧斗篷打满补丁，围巾裹住下半张脸，左手套边露出一块拱门形的胎记；腰间挂着一口青铜手钟，右手握着敲钟的短锤，胸前用皮绳挂着一把没有纹样的古旧钥匙。
subject.en: A tongueless bell ringer of the remnant folk, tall and thin, about thirty, a patched gray-brown old cloak, a scarf wrapped over the lower half of his face, an arch-shaped birthmark peeking out from the edge of his left glove; a bronze hand bell at his waist, a short striking hammer in his right hand, an old key with no markings hung on a leather cord at his chest.

extra.zh: 第 4 格画正常比例的胸像：围巾上方戒备的眼睛、胸前的古钥与手钟。前三格按 Q 版约 1.7 头身画，与场景里的人物是同一比例。
extra.en: Panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust: wary eyes above the scarf, the old key at his chest and the hand bell. Panels 1 to 3 use chibi proportions of about 1.7 heads tall, the same as the people in the scene.

subject.zh: 三十二岁的人族女拳手将军，高挑精壮，深红短发向后梳，左眉一道疤把眉毛断开，深褐眼睛带着战意，下颌左侧挂一枚染红的魔物獠牙耳坠。黑红轻甲 #1e1a1a、#8a1c22，不戴头盔，双手缠拳击绷带，戴一对铁拳套 #6a6a70。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A thirty-two-year-old human woman boxer general, tall and hard-muscled: dark red short hair swept back, a scar that splits her left eyebrow, dark brown eyes full of fight, a blood-red monster fang earring hanging at the left of her jaw. Black and red light armor #1e1a1a, #8a1c22, no helmet, boxing wraps on both hands under a pair of iron fist gauntlets #6a6a70. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。特殊技大摆拳：右拳后拉、身体拧转蓄力，第 2 帧一记大摆拳砸出，第 3 帧顺势转身，第 4 帧甩甩拳套复位。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Special move, haymaker: right fist drawn back and body twisting to load, frame 2 the big swing lands, frame 3 she follows through with the turn, frame 4 she shakes out the gauntlet and resets.

items.notes: 主要角色：整套帧图由人物类负责，这里只出首领战加的两条动作条与登场插画。她用拳头打仗，手里不拿武器。附本人的三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头。

subject.zh: 帝国第七军团的女将军，约四十岁，银灰短发贴着头皮，面容冷硬，眼神像在估量对手；穿赭红与钢灰相间的制式板甲（#8a3a26、#6a6e74），肩甲刻着军团徽记，披一件短披风，右手一柄窄长的军剑，左臂绑着小圆盾。
subject.en: A general of the imperial Seventh Legion, about forty, close-cropped silver-gray hair, a cold hard face, eyes that seem to be measuring her opponent; regulation plate armor in ochre-red and steel gray (#8a3a26, #6a6e74), the legion emblem carved on her pauldron, a short cape, a narrow long military sword in her right hand and a small round shield strapped to her left arm.

extra.zh: 第 4 格画正常比例的胸像：冷硬的面容与肩甲上的军团徽记。前三格按 Q 版约 1.7 头身画，与场景里的人物是同一比例。
extra.en: Panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust: the cold hard face and the legion emblem on the pauldron. Panels 1 to 3 use chibi proportions of about 1.7 heads tall, the same as the people in the scene.

subject.zh: 十九岁的少年勇者，精瘦，肩膀正在长宽。黑色短发利落，额前一缕翘发，黑眼睛明亮。白金色勇者铠 #e8e8f0，胸甲有光环纹，正红披风 #c8282a，深蓝内衬 #2a3a6a，手持剑身带光纹的圣剑，左手腕戴一只没电的黑色运动手环。热血真诚。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A nineteen-year-old young hero, lean with shoulders still filling out. Neat short black hair with one cowlick at the front, bright black eyes. White-gold hero armor #e8e8f0 with a halo pattern on the breastplate, a true red cape #c8282a, deep blue lining #2a3a6a, a holy sword with glowing lines along the blade, a dead black fitness band on his left wrist. Hot-blooded and sincere. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。特殊技光相斩：双手把圣剑举过头顶蓄力，第 2 帧一记竖劈落下，第 3 帧剑尖触地，第 4 帧收剑复位；不画剑光，剑身光纹由渲染层点亮。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Special move, light-aspect cleave: both hands lift the holy sword overhead to gather power, frame 2 a vertical cut comes down, frame 3 the tip touches the ground, frame 4 he recovers; no sword glow, the blade patterns are lit by the renderer.

items.notes: 主要角色：整套帧图由人物类负责，这里只出首领战加的两条动作条与登场插画；第二条是回光（一场一次的自愈），不是狂暴。附本人的三视图作参照；三行依次是面向镜头、朝右、背向镜头。

subject.zh: 六十岁上下的人族大主教，瘦高挺直，白发剪得很短，神情笃定；穿白底金纹的主教长袍，头戴高主教冠（#f2efe6、#c9a646），胸前垂着金色光环纹的圣带，双手握着一柄顶端是光环的金色长权杖。
subject.en: A human archbishop of about sixty, tall, thin and upright, white hair cut very short, a certain and settled expression; a white archbishop robe with gold patterns and a tall miter (#f2efe6, #c9a646), a gold halo-patterned stole down his chest, a long gold crozier topped with a halo held in both hands.

subject.zh: 高大的鬼人副将，约两米二，赭红色厚皮（#a85a3a），额上两支粗黑的角，一支角尖缠着红布，下颌两颗短獠牙，肌肉夸张；穿夜境的黑红半身甲，双腕各套着一只被砸断的铁枷，断链拖在手边，双手抡一柄粗重的狼牙棒。

subject.zh: 三十多岁的人族女人，瘦削，眼神狂热，深色长发编成一条粗辫；穿灰色兜帽长袍，袍下是便于行动的皮马甲，双手手背都画着门形记号，腰间挂着一串拓着门纹的布片，右手握一根缠着铜线的引导长杖。

subject.zh: 白瓷烧成的执事之形，约两米半高，左右完全对称，身体像一件空心的瓷器长袍（#ede8dc、#d8c27a），没有脸，光滑的瓷面上描着金线的几何纹，双手各托一只瓷制骨匣，背后竖着一面圆形的瓷片光盘。行动时身体上下不动，平移滑行。
subject.en: A deacon figure fired from white porcelain, about two and a half meters tall, perfectly symmetrical left to right, its body like a hollow porcelain robe (#ede8dc, #d8c27a), no face, only a smooth porcelain surface traced with gold-line geometric patterns, a porcelain reliquary held on each hand, a round disc of porcelain shards standing behind it. It moves by gliding level without bobbing.

extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the gold-line geometry on its porcelain face and one porcelain reliquary.

subject.zh: 教会暗守骑士的队长，约五十岁的人族男人，络腮短胡已经花白，神情疲惫而坚毅；穿没有纹章的旧白钢板甲，外罩褪成灰白的圣袍，袍上的金纹被刻意刮掉，右手长剑，左手提一盏昏黄的地下提灯。
subject.en: The captain of the church undercroft knights, a human man of about fifty with a short graying full beard, tired but resolute; old white-steel plate with no heraldry under a holy tabard faded to gray-white, its gold patterns deliberately scraped away, a longsword in his right hand and a dim yellow underground lantern in his left.

extra.en: Panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust: the graying beard, the tired eyes and the tabard with its gold scraped off. Panels 1 to 3 use chibi proportions of about 1.7 heads tall, the same as the people in the scene.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。整张图只画第一阶段的常态外形，后续阶段的变化不画进来。人形首领：按 Q 版约 1.7 头身画，大头、脸部极简，与场景里的人物是同一比例。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces away from the viewer (up), showing the back. Draw only the first-phase normal form in this sheet; leave out the changes of later phases. Humanoid boss: chibi proportions of about 1.7 heads tall, a big head and a minimal face, the same proportions as the people in the scene.

subject.zh: 殉光的圣者亡灵，高大的骸骨保有圣徒般安详的面容（瓷白的骨面，#ede8dc），穿千年前的白金圣袍，袍上满是缝补与烧痕，右手一柄苍白光纹的长剑，头后悬着一圈几何形的白金光环（#d8c27a），胸口嵌着一枚裂开的圣徽。以身献光时光环收紧，全身亮起裂纹。
subject.en: The undead remnant of a martyred saint, a tall skeleton keeping a serene saintly face (a porcelain-white bone face, #ede8dc), a white-and-gold holy robe from a thousand years ago full of patches and burn marks, a longsword with pale light patterns in his right hand, a geometric white-gold halo (#d8c27a) behind his head, a cracked holy emblem set in his chest. When he offers himself to the light the halo tightens and cracks of light open across his whole body.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写安详的瓷白骨面、几何光环与胸口裂开的圣徽。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the serene porcelain bone face, the geometric halo and the cracked emblem.

subject.zh: 禁书库里看守的猎犬澱像，约两米长，身体由层叠的书页与铁皮书脊拼成（#d8d2c0、#2b2b3a），关节处钉着铜书角，头是一本半张开的厚书，书页一开一合当作嘴，没有眼睛，鼻端吊着一枚铁书签当作嗅针；身上浮着淡紫的文字样纹路（#7a6a9a）。
subject.en: A guard-hound construct of a forbidden library, about two meters long, its body pieced from stacked pages and iron-clad book spines (#d8d2c0, #2b2b3a), brass book corners nailed at the joints, its head a thick half-open book whose pages open and shut as a mouth, no eyes, an iron bookmark hanging from its snout as a sniffing needle; pale purple script-like patterns (#7a6a9a) float over its body.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写书本做的头、开合的书页嘴与铁书签嗅针。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the book head, the page mouth and the iron bookmark needle.

subject.zh: 一团灰袍学者的残影，只有上半身，灰袍下摆化成一缕缕卷曲的墨线拖在地上（#2b2b3a、#b9b4a8），脸隐在兜帽阴影里，周身漂着许多纸条，纸条上满是像页边批注一样的细线；两只细长的手指沾着墨，在空中不停书写。
subject.en: The lingering shade of a gray-robed scholar, upper body only, the robe hem dissolving into curling strands of ink that drag on the ground (#2b2b3a, #b9b4a8), face hidden in the shadow of the hood, many slips of paper floating around it covered in fine lines like margin notes; two long thin ink-stained fingers write ceaselessly in the air.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写兜帽阴影与沾墨的书写手指。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the hood shadow and the ink-stained writing fingers.

subject.zh: 星象台的看守澱像，约三米半高，外形像一座会走的铜制天球仪，胸腔是嵌着星点的深蓝铜球（#1e2a4a、#c8a04a），外面套着几道可以转动的刻度圆环，四条细长的铜足，头部是一具望远镜筒，筒口透出白光。天穹落时圆环全部倒转。
subject.en: A guardian construct of an observatory, about three and a half meters tall, shaped like a walking brass armillary sphere, its chest a deep blue bronze globe studded with star points (#1e2a4a, #c8a04a) wrapped by several rotating graduated rings, four long thin brass legs, a telescope tube for a head with white light in its mouth. When the sky falls every ring spins backward.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写星点铜球与刻度圆环。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the starred bronze globe and the graduated rings.

subject.zh: 星象台的看守澱像，约三米半高，外形像一座会走的铜制天球仪，胸腔是嵌着星点的深蓝铜球（#1e2a4a、#c8a04a），外面套着几道可以转动的刻度圆环，四条细长的铜足，头部是一具望远镜筒，筒口透出白光。天穹落时圆环全部倒转。
subject.en: A guardian construct of an observatory, about three and a half meters tall, shaped like a walking brass armillary sphere, its chest a deep blue bronze globe studded with star points (#1e2a4a, #c8a04a) wrapped by several rotating graduated rings, four long thin brass legs, a telescope tube for a head with white light in its mouth. When the sky falls every ring spins backward.

subject.zh: 地下斗场的现任冠军，三十岁左右的人族角斗士，赤裸上身，古铜色皮肤上满是旧伤疤，头戴铁铸的桂冠形头盔（#6a6e74），右臂套着角斗士的鱼鳞护臂，左手方盾，右手短阔剑，腰缠赭红战裙（#8a3a26）。加护显形时伤口里透出赤光，眼神发狂。
subject.en: The reigning champion of an underground arena, a human gladiator of about thirty, bare-chested, bronze skin covered in old scars, a cast-iron laurel-shaped helmet (#6a6e74), a scaled gladiator manica on his right arm, a square shield in his left hand and a short broad sword in his right, an ochre-red war skirt (#8a3a26). When his hidden blessing shows, red light glows from his wounds and his eyes turn wild.

extra.zh: 第 4 格画正常比例的胸像：铁桂冠头盔与满身伤疤。前三格按 Q 版约 1.7 头身画，与场景里的人物是同一比例。
extra.en: Panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust: the iron laurel helmet and the scars. Panels 1 to 3 use chibi proportions of about 1.7 heads tall, the same as the people in the scene.

subject.zh: 沉船湾的巨型母蟹，壳宽约四米，深绿与赭褐的厚壳（#3a5a40、#6b4f1d）上粘满层层铜币与金币（#c9a227），像一本摊开的账本缝着钱；一对大小不一的巨钳，小钳专门夹钱，八条带甲的步足。每偷到一次，壳上就多一层钱币。
subject.en: A giant matriarch crab of a wreck-filled bay, shell about four meters wide, a thick dark green and ochre-brown shell (#3a5a40, #6b4f1d) caked with layers of copper and gold coins (#c9a227) like an open ledger sewn with money; one huge claw and one small claw used only for pinching coins, eight armored walking legs. Each theft adds another layer of coins to its shell.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写粘满钱币的壳面与夹着一枚金币的小钳。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the coin-caked shell and the small claw pinching a gold coin.

subject.zh: 违约的契约魔，约三米高，身体像一只被撑破的巨大钱袋，皮是旧羊皮纸的黄褐色（#c8b89a），布满裂开的封蜡印与断开的绳结，袋口裂成一张满是金牙的嘴（#c9a227），两条细长的手臂拖着撕碎的契约长卷，眼睛是两枚空洞的铜币。

subject.zh: 违约的契约魔，约三米高，身体像一只被撑破的巨大钱袋，皮是旧羊皮纸的黄褐色（#c8b89a），布满裂开的封蜡印与断开的绳结，袋口裂成一张满是金牙的嘴（#c9a227），两条细长的手臂拖着撕碎的契约长卷，眼睛是两枚空洞的铜币。
subject.en: A defaulted pact fiend about three meters tall, its body like a giant purse split at the seams, skin the yellow-brown of old parchment (#c8b89a) covered in cracked wax seals and broken knots, its mouth a torn opening full of gold teeth (#c9a227), two long thin arms dragging torn contract scrolls, two hollow copper coins for eyes.

subject.zh: 古港潮门的守门澱像，约四米高，身体是一扇长满藤壶与海藻的青铜潮门（#5a8a7a、#3a5a5a），门扇在胸前合拢，两侧伸出粗大的铰链手臂，头部是一座小小的门楼，楼顶挂着锈蚀的潮钟；腿是两根被海水泡白的石墩。
subject.en: The gatekeeper construct of an old harbor tide gate, about four meters tall, its body a bronze tide gate grown over with barnacles and seaweed (#5a8a7a, #3a5a5a), the gate leaves closed across its chest, thick hinged arms reaching out from the sides, a tiny gatehouse for a head with a corroded tide bell hanging from its roof; its legs are two stone piers bleached by the sea.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写门楼头部与锈蚀的潮钟。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the gatehouse head and the corroded tide bell.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。潮水由渲染层画；动作表里不画水。

subject.zh: 守冢的巨熊兽，肩高约三米，灰褐皮毛上长满青苔与草皮（#6a5a4a、#7a8a4a），背上长着几块风化的碑石，前掌巨大，熊爪像岩石，脖颈挂着彩绳与骨饰。苔藓疯长的阶段全身冒出新芽与蘑菇。
subject.en: A giant bear beast guarding a burial mound, about three meters at the shoulder, gray-brown fur overgrown with moss and turf (#6a5a4a, #7a8a4a), a few weathered stone stelae growing from its back, huge forepaws with rock-like claws, colored cords and bone ornaments around its neck. In the overgrowth phase fresh sprouts and mushrooms burst out all over it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写背上的风化碑石与颈上的彩绳骨饰。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the weathered stelae on its back and the cords and bone ornaments at its neck.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。苔藓疯长阶段用叠加件与色样行表现，动作表画常态。

subject.zh: 祖灵的嚎影，一团由许多兽人祖先的头与肩膀交叠成的灰蓝色魂形（#7a8aa0、#4a5a6a），有狼首、熊首与角首，嘴全都张开朝天长嚎，中央是一位戴骨冠的老萨满之影，下半身化成随风飘动的毡条与彩绳。
subject.en: The howling shade of the ancestors, a gray-blue spirit mass of many beastfolk ancestors' heads and shoulders overlapping (#7a8aa0, #4a5a6a), wolf heads, bear heads and horned heads, every mouth open howling at the sky, the shade of an old shaman wearing a bone crown at its center, its lower half dissolving into felt strips and colored cords streaming in the wind.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写中央戴骨冠的老萨满之影与两侧的兽首。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the bone-crowned shaman shade at the center and the beast heads beside it.

subject.zh: 被除名的老萨满亡灵，枯瘦的角族兽人骸骨，头上一对弯角缠着褪色的彩绳，披着破烂的毡袍，脖子上挂满蝗骨串成的项链，手持一根挂着骨铃的长杖，身周绕着一小团黄褐色的蝗群（#a8945a、#6a5a3a），胸前挂着一块空白的木牌。
subject.en: The undead of an old shaman whose name was struck out, a gaunt skeleton of a horned beastfolk, a pair of curved horns wound with faded colored cords, a ragged felt robe, necklaces of strung locust bones, a long staff hung with bone bells, a small cloud of yellow-brown locusts (#a8945a, #6a5a3a) circling him, a blank wooden tag hanging at his chest.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写缠彩绳的弯角、蝗骨项链与胸前的空白木牌。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the corded horns, the locust-bone necklaces and the blank wooden tag.

subject.zh: 熔渣凝成的潮使，约三米高，上半身是一个披着冷却黑渣甲壳的人形（#2a221e、#4a3e36），裂缝里流着橙红的熔渣（#e88a3a、#ffc070），下半身是一摊不断涌动的熔渣浪，双臂末端滴着火星；头部是一块挖出两道发光缝的渣块。
subject.en: A herald congealed from slag, about three meters tall, its upper body a humanoid shape armored in cooled black slag crust (#2a221e, #4a3e36) with orange-red molten slag (#e88a3a, #ffc070) flowing in its cracks, its lower body a constantly surging wave of slag, sparks dripping from the ends of its arms; its head a lump of slag with two glowing slits.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写渣块头部的两道发光缝与甲壳裂缝里的熔渣。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the two glowing slits in its slag head and the molten slag in the crust cracks.

subject.zh: 誓炉的锻工澱像，约两米半高的矮壮人形，由黄铜、铸铁与炉砖拼成（#c8a04a、#5a6268、#8a3a24），没有脸，头部是一盏敞口的小炉，炉口燃着火；宽大的铁手，身上烙满誓约印记，腰间挂着锻锤、长钳与风箱。三具同形，靠胸口烙印的颜色区分。
subject.en: A forge-oath smith construct, a squat humanoid about two and a half meters tall pieced from brass, cast iron and furnace brick (#c8a04a, #5a6268, #8a3a24), no face, its head a small open furnace with fire in its mouth; broad iron hands, oath brands burned all over its body, a forging hammer, long tongs and a bellows hanging at its waist. Three of them share this form, told apart only by the color of the brand on the chest.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写炉口头部与胸口的誓约烙印。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the furnace head and the oath brand on the chest.

subject.zh: 深炉最底下一座不肯熄灭的巨炉化成的澱像，约五米高，身躯是一座圆胖的炉膛（#4a3e36、#8a3a24），炉门开在腹部，里面翻滚着金白色的火（#ffc070），肩上伸出四根排气烟囱，两条粗短的铁臂抓着一柄巨锤。开炉时炉门大开，烟囱喷出火柱。
subject.en: A construct risen from a giant furnace at the very bottom of a deep forge that refuses to go out, about five meters tall, its body a round fat firebox (#4a3e36, #8a3a24) with the furnace door in its belly and gold-white fire (#ffc070) churning inside, four exhaust chimneys rising from its shoulders, two thick short iron arms gripping a giant hammer. When it opens the furnace the door swings wide and the chimneys spout columns of fire.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写腹部的炉门与肩上的排气烟囱。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the furnace door in its belly and the chimneys on its shoulders.

subject.zh: 深炉最底下一座不肯熄灭的巨炉化成的澱像，约五米高，身躯是一座圆胖的炉膛（#4a3e36、#8a3a24），炉门开在腹部，里面翻滚着金白色的火（#ffc070），肩上伸出四根排气烟囱，两条粗短的铁臂抓着一柄巨锤。开炉时炉门大开，烟囱喷出火柱。
subject.en: A construct risen from a giant furnace at the very bottom of a deep forge that refuses to go out, about five meters tall, its body a round fat firebox (#4a3e36, #8a3a24) with the furnace door in its belly and gold-white fire (#ffc070) churning inside, four exhaust chimneys rising from its shoulders, two thick short iron arms gripping a giant hammer. When it opens the furnace the door swings wide and the chimneys spout columns of fire.

subject.zh: 正午斗碑投下的影子化成的人形，约两米半高，全身是深黑带赤边的平面剪影（#1c1a1a、#b33a2a），轮廓像一名披斗篷的古代斗士，手里一柄断剑，断口泛着暗红；脚跟始终连着地上的碑影，移动时像影子被拉长。
subject.en: A humanoid shape risen from the shadow a dueling stele casts at noon, about two and a half meters tall, its whole body a flat deep black silhouette with a red rim (#1c1a1a, #b33a2a), the outline of an ancient cloaked duelist holding a broken sword whose snapped edge glows dark red; its heels stay joined to the stele shadow on the ground, and when it moves it stretches like a shadow.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写断剑的断口与剪影的赤色边。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the broken sword edge and the red rim of the silhouette.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。全身几乎是平涂黑剪影，只有赤边与断口有颜色；地上的碑影由渲染层画。

subject.zh: 盘踞在巨树根间的巨蛛，腿展约五米，腐木般的灰褐甲壳（#5a4a3a、#3a3028）长着苔与白色菌丝，背上一块像腐烂树瘤的大鼓包，八条细长的节肢，八只青白的小眼（#c8e0a0），吐出的网丝湿黏发绿。
subject.en: A giant spider nesting among the roots of a huge tree, legs spanning about five meters, a gray-brown carapace like rotten wood (#5a4a3a, #3a3028) grown with moss and white fungal threads, a great bulge on its back like a rotting burl, eight long thin jointed legs, eight small pale green-white eyes (#c8e0a0), wet sticky greenish web silk.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写八只青白小眼与背上像腐烂树瘤的鼓包。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the eight pale eyes and the rotting-burl bulge on its back.

subject.zh: 根尖上长出的一株苗，约两米高，嫩绿的茎干蜷成一个弓着背的小小身形（#7aa06a、#c8e0a0），叶片却已发黑卷曲，脚下盘结的根须拖在地上挪动，顶端开着一朵苍白的小花；根须向它输送时全身脉络亮起绿光。
subject.en: A seedling grown from a root tip, about two meters tall, its tender green stem curled into a small hunched figure (#7aa06a, #c8e0a0) whose leaves are already blackened and curling, a tangle of roots at its base dragging along as it moves, a pale little flower at its tip; when the roots feed it, the veins of its whole body light up green.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写顶端的苍白小花与发黑卷曲的叶片。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the pale flower at its tip and the blackened curling leaves.

subject.zh: 悬在半空的一顶巨大铁冠，约一米半宽，由四只弯曲的黑铁兽角锻接成冠（#3a3a44、#5a1a16），冠环上铸着粗犷的夜境纹样，角根处嵌着暗红的晶，冠下拖着几缕赤黑的雾；每碎一只角，冠就倾斜一些。
subject.en: A huge iron crown hanging in midair, about one and a half meters wide, forged from four curved black-iron beast horns joined into a crown (#3a3a44, #5a1a16), rough night-realm patterns cast into its band, dark red crystals set at the base of each horn, a few wisps of red-black mist trailing beneath it; each time a horn breaks, the crown tilts a little more.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写一只铁角的角根与嵌着的暗红晶。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of one horn base with its dark red crystal.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。首领本体就是一顶冠，没有身体。它左右对称、会旋转，只出正面一张动作表；第 2 行移动画成飞行时的倾斜与旋转，第 5 行特殊技画飞向目标的加冕俯冲。四只角的位置固定，供导入工具标注可碎部位。

subject.zh: 一位古代鬼人酋长的残影，约三米高，原本赭红的厚皮已化成灰烬色（#8a8580），头上两支铁角长成冠的样子，下颌獠牙外露，披着厚重的黑毛皮大氅，手持一柄巨大的弯刃战刀，身影边缘像烟一样散开；南征冲锋时整个身体前倾拉长。
subject.en: The lingering echo of an ancient oni chieftain, about three meters tall, his once ochre-red hide turned ash-colored (#8a8580), two iron horns grown into the shape of a crown, tusks jutting from his lower jaw, a heavy black fur mantle, a huge curved war blade in hand, the edges of his form dispersing like smoke; when he charges south his whole body leans forward and stretches.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写长成冠形的铁角与下颌獠牙。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the crown-shaped iron horns and the tusks.

subject.zh: 吞下门钥的晶脊蜈之母，体长约八米，比晶脊蜈粗壮一倍，深蓝灰的甲节（#3c4a58、#12171c）上的晶刺长成一排排门框形的晶拱（#7fa6c6、#d6ecff），腹部透出一团暖白偏金的光（#f0d890），头上一对巨大的弯钳。
subject.en: The mother of the crystal-spined centipedes, grown huge after swallowing a door key, about eight meters long and twice as thick as its offspring, its deep blue-gray segments (#3c4a58, #12171c) bearing rows of crystal arches shaped like door frames (#7fa6c6, #d6ecff), a glow of warm white with a touch of gold (#f0d890) showing through its belly, a pair of huge curved pincers on its head.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写门框形的晶拱与腹部透出的暖金光。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the door-frame crystal arches and the warm gold glow through the belly.

subject.zh: 吞下门钥的晶脊蜈之母，体长约八米，比晶脊蜈粗壮一倍，深蓝灰的甲节（#3c4a58、#12171c）上的晶刺长成一排排门框形的晶拱（#7fa6c6、#d6ecff），腹部透出一团暖白偏金的光（#f0d890），头上一对巨大的弯钳。
subject.en: The mother of the crystal-spined centipedes, grown huge after swallowing a door key, about eight meters long and twice as thick as its offspring, its deep blue-gray segments (#3c4a58, #12171c) bearing rows of crystal arches shaped like door frames (#7fa6c6, #d6ecff), a glow of warm white with a touch of gold (#f0d890) showing through its belly, a pair of huge curved pincers on its head.

extra.zh: 画它昂起前身，腹中的光透出甲节缝隙。
extra.en: Show it rearing its front body with the light in its belly shining through the seams.

subject.zh: 夜境黑市的钥贩，蛇人，细鳞覆面（#3a5a40、#6a8a6a），颈侧的颈褶半张，金黄竖瞳，舌尖分叉；穿深紫长外套，外套内衬缝满成百上千把各式钥匙，手指上戴满戒指，腰间挂一盏暗红小灯，手里转着一把没有纹样的古旧钥匙。
subject.en: A key dealer of the night-realm black market, a serpentfolk with fine scales over his face (#3a5a40, #6a8a6a), neck frills half spread, golden slit pupils, a forked tongue tip; a long deep purple coat whose lining is sewn with hundreds of assorted keys, rings on every finger, a small dark red lamp at his waist, an old key with no markings twirling in his hand.

extra.en: Panel 4 is a normal-proportion bust: the half-spread neck frill, the slit pupils and the key-lined coat. Panels 1 to 3 use chibi proportions of about 1.7 heads tall, the same as the people in the scene.

subject.zh: 岩掌部的熊族战首，深相：完整的棕黑熊首与全身粗毛（#4a3a2a、#2a221e），体型比常人大两成，戴熊掌形铁护手，胸前挂着狼牙与铁片串成的护符，披一块缀着红毡条的兽皮，双手抡一柄石头大锤。带着狂战加护时眼睛发红、毛发倒竖。
subject.en: The bear-folk warchief of the Rockpaw tribe, deep aspect: a full brown-black bear head and coarse fur all over (#4a3a2a, #2a221e), a fifth larger than most people, bear-paw iron gauntlets, an amulet of strung wolf fangs and iron plates on his chest, a hide draped over him hung with red felt strips, a great stone hammer swung in both hands. Under his berserk blessing his eyes turn red and his fur stands on end.

extra.zh: 第 4 格画正常比例的胸像：熊首、熊掌形铁护手与胸前的狼牙护符。前三格按 Q 版约 1.7 头身画，与场景里的人物是同一比例。

subject.zh: 千年断刃聚成的巨大武士之形，约九米高，全身由数不清的断剑、残枪与碎盾层层插叠而成（#8e9298、#6a6e74、#8a3a26），关节处是缠着旧军旗布的剑堆，头部像一顶由剑尖围成的冠，没有脸；剑冠阶段全身断剑竖起、根根发亮。
subject.en: A giant warrior shape gathered from a thousand years of broken blades, about nine meters tall, its whole body layered from countless broken swords, shattered spears and smashed shields (#8e9298, #6a6e74, #8a3a26), its joints heaps of swords bound with old war banner cloth, its head like a crown ringed with sword points, no face; in the sword-crown phase every broken blade on its body stands up and gleams.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写剑尖围成的冠形头部与缠着军旗布的关节。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the crown of sword points and a joint wrapped in banner cloth.

subject.en: A giant warrior shape gathered from a thousand years of broken blades, about nine meters tall, its whole body layered from countless broken swords, shattered spears and smashed shields (#8e9298, #6a6e74, #8a3a26), its joints heaps of swords bound with old war banner cloth, its head like a crown ringed with sword points, no face; in the sword-crown phase every broken blade on its body stands up and gleams.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。部件：躯干、剑冠头部、左右上臂、左右前臂、左右大腿、左右小腿、背后一捆可以单独摆动的长矛。整张图只画第一阶段的常态外形，后续阶段的变化不画进来。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces away from the viewer (up), showing the back. Parts: torso, sword-crown head, left and right upper arms, left and right forearms, left and right thighs, left and right shins, and a bundle of long spears on its back that swings on its own. Draw only the first-phase normal form in this sheet; leave out the changes of later phases.

subject.zh: 一团黄褐色的巨大蝗云（#a8945a、#6a5a3a），约六米宽，翅膀摩擦成一片闪烁的光点，中心悬着一顶由白骨与兽角拼成的骨冠（#e0d08e、#d8d0bc），冠下垂着几缕干草与碎骨。分成三团时每团中心都有一片骨；最后阶段骨冠完全显形，放出暗红的光。
subject.en: A huge yellow-brown cloud of locusts (#a8945a, #6a5a3a), about six meters wide, wings rubbing into a field of flickering specks, a crown pieced from white bone and beast horn (#e0d08e, #d8d0bc) hanging at its center with wisps of dry grass and bone shards dangling beneath. When it splits into three clouds each has a bone shard at its heart; in the last phase the bone crown fully appears and gives off a dark red light.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写骨冠：白骨与兽角的拼接处。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the bone crown where bone and horn are pieced together.

subject.zh: 成千上万只拟金小魔聚成的一道金色潮浪，约五米宽，远看像一堆滚动的金币（#c9a227、#6b4f1d），近看每枚金币都长着细腿与小嘴；潮头隆起成一张巨口，口里是更多的金币与偷来的杂物；吞得越多，表面越像镀了一层硬金甲。
subject.en: A golden tidal wave of tens of thousands of coin-mimic critters, about five meters wide, from afar a rolling heap of gold coins (#c9a227, #6b4f1d), up close every coin has thin legs and a tiny mouth; the crest rises into a huge maw full of more coins and stolen odds and ends; the more it swallows, the more its surface looks plated in hard gold armor.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写几枚长着细腿与小嘴的假金币。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of a few fake coins with thin legs and tiny mouths.

subject.zh: 夜境亡兵聚成的一堵冲锋之潮，约六米宽，几十具穿黑红残甲的鬼人与夜魔骸骨（#2e2a2c、#5a1a16、#d8d0bc）肩并肩挤成一体，最前排是一整排向前伸出的赤红角与长矛（#b33a2a），潮顶飘着几面破碎的军旗。红角冲时整潮低头前压。
subject.en: A charging tide of night-realm dead, about six meters wide, dozens of oni and night-demon skeletons in tattered black-and-red armor (#2e2a2c, #5a1a16, #d8d0bc) crushed shoulder to shoulder into one mass, a whole front rank of crimson horns and spears (#b33a2a) thrust forward, a few torn war banners flying above. In the red-horn charge the whole tide lowers its heads and presses forward.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写最前排的赤角与长矛。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the front rank of crimson horns and spears.

subject.zh: 枯林里的孵蝗母，体长约四米的巨蝗，臃肿的黄褐腹部（#a8945a、#6a5a3a）拖在地上，布满一排排卵囊，四片残破的灰翅，长长的后足带着锯齿，头上一对复眼泛着病态的绿；飞起时腹部抖落一阵黄粉。
subject.en: A brood-mother locust of a withered wood, a giant locust about four meters long, its swollen yellow-brown abdomen (#a8945a, #6a5a3a) dragging on the ground lined with rows of egg sacs, four tattered gray wings, long serrated hind legs, compound eyes glinting a sickly green; when it takes off its abdomen shakes loose a shower of yellow powder.

subject.zh: 一朵约三米高的巨花，花茎粗如树干，层层叠叠的花冠同时开着新瓣与腐瓣（#e8eee8、#6b7f3a、#4a3b2a），花心是一团缓缓旋转的种荚，根须在地上拖行。随季节变化：春天嫩绿，夏天泛橙红，秋天发黑腐烂，冬天结满白霜。
subject.en: A giant flower about three meters tall, its stem thick as a tree trunk, a layered corolla blooming with fresh petals and rotting petals at once (#e8eee8, #6b7f3a, #4a3b2a), a slowly turning cluster of seed pods at its heart, roots dragging on the ground. It changes with the seasons: tender green in spring, orange-red in summer, black and rotting in autumn, covered in white frost in winter.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写花心旋转的种荚与一半新一半腐的花瓣。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the turning seed pods and petals half fresh, half rotting.

subject.zh: 深渊边缘的一张巨口，从岩地里张开的肉质深穴，宽约六米，口沿是一圈暗红的肉褶与黑岩利齿（#5a1a16、#1c1a1a），深处翻滚着赤黑的澱，口沿伸出几条吸附的肉须；吸的时候整张口向内收缩。
subject.en: A huge mouth at the edge of an abyss, a fleshy pit gaping open in the rock floor, about six meters wide, its rim a ring of dark red flesh folds and black rock teeth (#5a1a16, #1c1a1a), red-black dian churning in its depths, several grasping flesh tendrils reaching out from the rim; when it sucks, the whole mouth contracts inward.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写口沿的肉褶、黑岩利齿与一条肉须。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the flesh folds, black rock teeth and one tendril on the rim.

subject.zh: 一位夜魔大贵族的亡影，修长苍白，灰蓝皮肤（#5e5a62、#c8c8d8），黑色眼白配银色虹膜，后掠的细角，发丝像烟一样漂浮；穿古旧的深红礼服与高领斗篷（#5a1a16），胸前一枚暗红的月形饰，指甲细长。月蚀时斗篷张开遮住整个身形。
subject.en: The afterimage of a great night-demon noble, tall, slender and pale, gray-blue skin (#5e5a62, #c8c8d8), black sclera with silver irises, thin swept-back horns, hair floating like smoke; an antique deep red formal coat and a high-collared cloak (#5a1a16), a dark red crescent ornament at the chest, long thin nails. During the eclipse the cloak spreads to hide his whole form.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写黑眼白银虹膜、后掠细角与胸前的月形饰。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the black-and-silver eyes, swept-back horns and the crescent ornament.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。整张图只画第一阶段的常态外形，后续阶段的变化不画进来。飞行首领：本体画在每格的上半部，第 2 行移动画成盘旋飞行，不对齐地面基线。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces away from the viewer (up), showing the back. Draw only the first-phase normal form in this sheet; leave out the changes of later phases. Flying boss: draw the body in the upper half of each cell, row 2 is circling flight, not aligned to a ground baseline.

subject.zh: 一个鬼人少年的亡影，身形瘦小（不到两米），青黑的皮肤结满白霜（#3a4a5a、#d8e8f4），额上两支被冰包住的短角，穿一件过大的旧军大衣，赤着脚，拖着一柄比他还高的冰矛；身边绕着冬风与几块浮游的霜骨。
subject.en: The afterimage of an oni boy, small and thin (under two meters), blue-black skin crusted with white frost (#3a4a5a, #d8e8f4), two short horns encased in ice on his brow, an old military greatcoat far too big for him, bare feet, dragging an ice spear taller than himself; winter wind and a few drifting frost bones circle him.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写被冰包住的短角与过大的军大衣领口。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the ice-encased horns and the collar of the oversized greatcoat.

subject.zh: 一团没有成形的巨胎之影，约五米高，像一个蜷缩的巨人胚胎，赤黑半凝的澱（#5a1a16、#1c1a1a、#4a3a62）包着一层薄膜，膜下隐约有角与爪在成形又消失，头顶空着一圈没有冠的环印；无冠阶段胚胎舒展开，长出四肢。
subject.en: The shadow of a giant unformed fetus, about five meters tall, like a curled giant embryo, half-congealed red-black dian (#5a1a16, #1c1a1a, #4a3a62) wrapped in a thin membrane, horns and claws faintly forming and vanishing beneath it, an empty ring mark with no crown on top of its head; in the crownless phase the embryo unfurls and grows limbs.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写薄膜下成形中的角与头顶空着的环印。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the horns forming under the membrane and the empty ring mark on its head.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。动作表画蜷缩悬浮的胚胎形；舒展开的样子只画在登场插画与第 5 行特殊技的后几帧。

subject.zh: 冢前的盾卫亡灵，高大魁梧的骸骨，穿古旧的银灰重甲与残破的雪白斗篷，手持一面比人还高的方形塔盾，盾面刻着一道深深的剑痕；头盔没有面甲，骨脸平静，眼窝里一点冰蓝的光。站定时塔盾立地。
subject.en: The undead shield guard before a tomb, a tall broad skeleton in old silver-gray heavy armor and a tattered snow-white cloak, holding a square tower shield taller than a man with one deep sword scar carved across it; an open-faced helm, a calm bone face, a point of ice-blue light in each socket. When it stands still the tower shield is planted on the ground.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写塔盾上的剑痕与平静的骨脸。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the sword scar on the tower shield and the calm bone face.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。亡灵人形，不用 Q 版比例。盾击画在攻击甲，第 5 行特殊技画举盾冲撞。

subject.zh: 本该烧尽却逆流的光凝成的澱像，约三米高，一道倒着流动的苍白光柱被几何形的瓷片拼成人形（#ede8dc、#d8c27a、#9db4c8），胸前是一把只有剑柄的光剑的虚形，碎片之间有裂缝；终斩回响时全身碎片张开。
subject.en: A construct of light that should have burned out but flowed backward, about three meters tall, a pale column of reversed light pieced into a human shape by geometric porcelain shards (#ede8dc, #d8c27a, #9db4c8), at its chest the outline of a light sword with only a hilt, cracks between the shards; when the echo of the final strike comes, every shard on its body spreads open.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写胸前只有剑柄的光剑虚形与瓷片之间的裂缝。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the hilt-only light sword outline and the cracks between the shards.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。光柱的流动由渲染层与特效层做，动作表里画成苍白的实色。瓷片张开画在第 5 行特殊技。

subject.zh: 本该烧尽却逆流的光凝成的澱像，约三米高，一道倒着流动的苍白光柱被几何形的瓷片拼成人形（#ede8dc、#d8c27a、#9db4c8），胸前是一把只有剑柄的光剑的虚形，碎片之间有裂缝；终斩回响时全身碎片张开。
subject.en: A construct of light that should have burned out but flowed backward, about three meters tall, a pale column of reversed light pieced into a human shape by geometric porcelain shards (#ede8dc, #d8c27a, #9db4c8), at its chest the outline of a light sword with only a hilt, cracks between the shards; when the echo of the final strike comes, every shard on its body spreads open.

subject.zh: 一名身形修长的勇者的残念，穿古旧的勇者铠，铠上的光环纹被划掉，披着撕裂的深蓝披风（#2a3e52），面容清瘦，眼窝里是冷白的光，右手一柄失去光纹的旧剑；身上没有任何神赐的光，只有雪落在肩上。
subject.en: The lingering will of a tall slender hero, in antique hero armor whose halo patterns have been scratched out, a torn deep blue cape (#2a3e52), a lean face with cold white light in the eye sockets, an old sword that has lost its light patterns in his right hand; no god-given light on him at all, only snow settling on his shoulders.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写被划掉光环纹的胸甲与失去光纹的旧剑。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the breastplate with its halo pattern scratched out and the old sword with no light.

subject.zh: 一组被藤壶与珊瑚包住的唱诗者，四五个溺亡者的身形长在同一块礁石座上（#5a8a7a、#3a5a5a、#e8dcc4），嘴全部张开，喉咙里是一个个藤壶的孔，头上顶着海螺与贝壳的冠，礁石座底部长着触须拖行。
subject.en: A choir encased in barnacles and coral, four or five drowned figures grown from a single reef base (#5a8a7a, #3a5a5a, #e8dcc4), every mouth open with barnacle holes for throats, crowns of conch and shell on their heads, tendrils under the reef base dragging it along.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写张开的嘴里的藤壶孔与贝壳冠。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the barnacle holes in their open mouths and the shell crowns.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。一群合成一个首领，礁石座是整体，整团移动。

subject.zh: 沉舰提督的亡灵，泡得发白的高大骸骨，穿旧式海军长外套，金扣与肩章已经发绿（#2e4a6e、#8a7a5a），头戴三角帽，帽檐挂着海草，一手持指挥刀，一手提着一门小型手炮，背后插着一面湿透的旗帜残片。
subject.en: The undead of a drowned fleet admiral, a tall skeleton bleached by the sea, an old-style naval long coat whose gold buttons and epaulettes have gone green (#2e4a6e, #8a7a5a), a tricorn hat with seaweed hanging from its brim, a command saber in one hand and a small hand cannon in the other, a soaked fragment of a flag stuck on his back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写发绿的金扣肩章与挂海草的三角帽。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the greened epaulettes and the seaweed-hung tricorn.

subject.zh: 巨鲸沉骸里的一颗心，约四米高的巨大心脏，被锈蚀的铜管、铁箍与锚链捆成一台机器（#8a3a2a、#5a6268、#b5643a），暗红的心肌在铁箍之间搏动，几条粗大的血管像缆绳一样拖在地上，顶上伸出两根冒蒸汽的铜管。
subject.en: A heart in a giant whale wreck, a huge heart about four meters tall bound into a machine with corroded copper pipes, iron hoops and anchor chains (#8a3a2a, #5a6268, #b5643a), dark red heart muscle pulsing between the hoops, several thick vessels dragging on the ground like cables, two steaming copper pipes rising from its top.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写铁箍之间鼓起的心肌与冒汽的铜管。

subject.zh: 深海巨物残留的形骸，体长二十米以上，像鲸与深海鱼的混合，半边身体只剩巨大的白骨，另半边是暗青的残肉与藤壶（#14202a、#1e4a6e、#e8dcc4），头部是一张长满细齿的巨口与一只浑浊的大眼，鳍边垂着断裂的锚链。
subject.en: The remaining hulk of a deep-sea colossus, over twenty meters long, like a cross between a whale and a deep-sea fish, half its body only huge white bone, the other half dark teal remnant flesh and barnacles (#14202a, #1e4a6e, #e8dcc4), its head a huge mouth lined with fine teeth and one great cloudy eye, broken anchor chains hanging from its fins.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写浑浊的大眼与长满细齿的口沿。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the great cloudy eye and the fine-toothed mouth rim.

subject.zh: 巨大的无貌之形，约六米高，修长的身形裹在层层黑灰的旧斗篷里，下摆像墨一样往下滴澱（#0e0e12、#2a2a34），脸是一片光滑的空白平面，正中一道门形细缝透出暗紫的光（#6a2a8a）；双手缠着绷带，身后悬着由澱构成、倒置扭曲的层层门扉。
subject.en: A huge faceless shape about six meters tall, a long slender body wrapped in layer on layer of old black-gray cloaks whose hems drip dian like ink (#0e0e12, #2a2a34), a face that is a smooth blank plane split down the middle by a thin door-shaped crack leaking dark purple light (#6a2a8a); bandaged hands, and behind it hang layered doors made of dian, inverted and twisted.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写空白的脸与正中门形细缝透出的暗紫光。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the blank face and the purple light in the door-shaped crack.

subject.zh: 一片开与烂同时发生的花潮，约六米宽，雪白的花朵（#e8eee8）层层盛开，花瓣边缘却在发黑腐烂（#4a3b2a、#6b7f3a），花丛中央升起一顶由枯藤与腐冠菇编成的冠，藤墙从花潮里伸出；花与烂互换时整片颜色翻转。
subject.en: A tide of flowers blooming and rotting at once, about six meters wide, snow-white blossoms (#e8eee8) opening in layers while their petal edges blacken and rot (#4a3b2a, #6b7f3a), a crown woven of dead vines and rot-cap mushrooms rising at its center, walls of vines reaching out of the tide; when bloom and rot swap, the colors of the whole tide flip.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写枯藤与腐冠菇编成的冠。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the crown woven of dead vines and rot-cap mushrooms.

subject.zh: 光之女神的模样：高挑的女子，白金长发一丝不乱垂到腰，白金色眼睛，目光像在测量尺寸。白与金的长袍左右绝对对称，领口与袖口镶几何纹金边，白 #f4f2ea、金 #d8b860，背后悬着精密的几何纹光环，像缓慢转动的齿轮。神情端正而冷淡。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of light as a tall woman: immaculate platinum hair falling straight to the waist, platinum eyes with a measuring gaze. Perfectly symmetrical white and gold robes with geometric gold trim at collar and cuffs, white #f4f2ea, gold #d8b860, a precise geometric halo floating behind her like slowly turning gears. Composed, cool expression. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。规格审定：第 1 到 4 帧双手在身前比出直角、缓缓抬起，第 5 到 8 帧双掌向地面压下，第 6 帧是压下的瞬间；地上的光格由特效层画。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Specification Review: frames 1 to 4 her hands frame a right angle before her and rise slowly, frames 5 to 8 both palms press down toward the floor, frame 6 is the moment of pressing; the light grid on the floor is drawn by the effects layer.

subject.zh: 争斗女神的模样：高大健硕的女战士，古铜肤色上满是旧伤疤，暗红蓬乱长发，金红色眼睛，笑起来露出尖牙。头上一对弯角，右角断了半截。红黑战甲 #8a1c1c、#1e1a1a，肩甲满是刀痕，肩上扛着一把断剑。豪爽好斗。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of strife as a towering, muscular woman warrior: bronze skin covered in old scars, wild dark red long hair, red-gold eyes, a fanged grin. A pair of curved horns, the right one broken halfway. Red and black battle armor #8a1c1c, #1e1a1a, pauldrons covered in blade nicks, a broken sword resting on her shoulder. Boisterous and eager for a fight. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。断剑连斩：第 1 帧断剑从肩上抡起，第 2 帧重重斩下，第 3 帧借势回身，第 4 帧剑尖拖地复位。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Broken-sword chain cut: frame 1 the broken sword swings up off her shoulder, frame 2 it slams down, frame 3 she rides the momentum around, frame 4 she recovers with the tip dragging the ground.

subject.zh: 交易女神的模样：半身人般的小个子女人，只到常人胸口，圆脸，脸颊几点雀斑，蜂蜜金卷发扎两个小发髻，金色眼睛笑得弯弯。多口袋的朱红商人外套镶金边 #b8402a、#e0b040，腋下夹一本厚账本，手里捏着一块点心，身边浮着几枚旋转的金币。Q 版约 1.6 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of trade as a halfling-sized woman who reaches an adult's chest: round face with a few freckles, honey-gold curls in two small buns, golden eyes curved in a smile. A vermilion merchant coat full of pockets with gold trim #b8402a, #e0b040, a thick ledger under one arm, a pastry in her hand, a few gold coins spinning in the air around her. Chibi about 1.6 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。金币契约：第 1 到 4 帧翻开账本、指尖在页上点算，第 5 到 8 帧弹出一枚金币并按下手掌，第 6 帧是金币弹出的瞬间；不画光效。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Coin Contract: frames 1 to 4 she opens the ledger and tallies on the page with a fingertip, frames 5 to 8 she flicks out a gold coin and presses her palm down, frame 6 is the moment the coin flies; no glow effects.

subject.zh: 生命女神的模样：纤瘦轻盈的女子，苍白肤色，苍绿长发长及膝盖，发间同时插着枯花与新开的花，常闭着眼，神情安静。苔绿与枯叶褐的层叠薄衣像落叶 #6a8a5a、#8a6a42，赤足。动作又轻又慢。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of life as a slender, weightless woman: pale skin, knee-length pale green hair woven with both withered and freshly opened flowers, eyes usually closed, a quiet expression. Layered thin garments in moss green and dead-leaf brown like fallen leaves #6a8a5a, #8a6a42, barefoot. Moves lightly and slowly. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。季节更替：第 1 到 4 帧双手在胸前合拢、长发缓缓扬起，第 5 到 8 帧双手向两侧展开，第 6 帧是展开的瞬间，发间的花随之开落。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Turn of Seasons: frames 1 to 4 her hands close before her chest as her hair slowly lifts, frames 5 to 8 she spreads her arms wide, frame 6 is the moment they open, the flowers in her hair blooming and falling.

subject.zh: 记录女神的模样：身形修长的兜帽书记官，墨蓝兜帽长袍 #2a3450，兜帽下露出栗色短发与常带笑的嘴角，左眼前悬一片刻着细纹的圆镜片，指尖沾着墨。腰后拖着一条羊皮纸色长卷轴 #e8dcc0 一直垂到地上，身边浮着一本翻开的书。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: The goddess of record as a tall hooded scribe: ink-blue hooded robe #2a3450, chestnut short hair and a ready smile under the hood, a round lens etched with fine lines hovering before her left eye, ink-stained fingertips. A parchment-colored scroll #e8dcc0 trails from her waist down to the ground, an open book floats beside her. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。改写：第 1 到 4 帧提笔悬在卷轴上方、镜片一闪，第 5 到 8 帧在空中划下一笔，第 6 帧是落笔的瞬间，卷轴随之翻卷。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Rewrite: frames 1 to 4 the pen hovers over the scroll as the lens glints, frames 5 to 8 she slashes a stroke through the air, frame 6 is the moment the pen strikes, the scroll rolling up with it.

subject.zh: 在现实里现身的高挑女人：深褐长发，左半张脸带着温柔的笑，暖琥珀色眼睛，右半边身体化作一道暖金色的门框 #f0d890，门框里是幽暗的空。深夜蓝长袍 #262c48 只裹住另一半身体，腰间挂满大小不一的旧钥匙。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A tall woman appearing in the waking world: dark brown hair, the left half of her face smiling gently with a warm amber eye, the right half of her body turned into a warm gold door frame #f0d890 with dim emptiness inside it. A midnight blue robe #262c48 wraps only the other half of her body, old keys of every size hanging at her waist. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。开门：第 1 到 4 帧抬手按在身旁一扇看不见的门上，第 5 到 8 帧把门推开，第 6 帧是门开的瞬间；门后的光由特效层画。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Opening a door: frames 1 to 4 she raises a hand to an unseen door beside her, frames 5 to 8 she pushes it open, frame 6 is the moment it opens; the light behind the door is drawn by the effects layer.

subject.zh: 骸骨守门人：人形骨架，眼眶里两点灰蓝冷火。披一件褪成灰白的古朴亚麻长袍 #c8c4b8，额骨上嵌一枚铜绿色的门形铜饰 #5a8a7a，指骨间夹一支芦苇笔，身上落着灰。炭黑、冷蓝、铜绿。安静而压迫。Q 版约 1.7 头身，头像立绘正常比例。
subject.en: A skeletal gatekeeper: a human skeleton with two points of cold grey-blue fire in its eye sockets. An antique linen robe faded to ash white #c8c4b8, a verdigris door-shaped copper ornament #5a8a7a set into the brow bone, a reed pen held between finger bones, ash settled on him. Charcoal, cold blue, verdigris. Quiet and oppressive. Chibi about 1.7 heads tall; portraits and busts use normal proportions.

extra.zh: 这是首领战专用的动作条。以灰写字：第 1 到 4 帧抬起芦苇笔、灰从袍角扬起，第 5 到 8 帧在空中写下一行，第 6 帧是落笔的瞬间；写出的字迹由特效层画，素材里不写字。
extra.en: This is a boss-fight-only animation strip. Writing in ash: frames 1 to 4 he lifts the reed pen as ash stirs from his robe hem, frames 5 to 8 he writes a line in the air, frame 6 is the moment the pen strikes; the written trace is drawn by the effects layer, no writing in the sprite.

subject.zh: 五位女神的化身同时现身：白金齿轮光环的光之女神居中，左边是扛断剑、穿红黑战甲的女神与夹着账本、身边漂着金币的小个子女神，右边是闭眼赤足、发间有枯花与新花的女神与拖着长卷轴的兜帽书记官女神。
subject.en: The avatars of five goddesses appearing together: the goddess of light with her platinum gear halo at the center, on the left the goddess in red-and-black war armor with a broken sword on her shoulder and the small goddess with a ledger under her arm and coins floating around her, on the right the barefoot goddess with eyes closed and withered and fresh flowers in her hair and the hooded scribe goddess trailing a long scroll.

extra.zh: 构图：五位女神围成一圈向内俯视，圈心空着留给挑战者。插画用正常的人体比例，不用 Q 版。
extra.en: Composition: the five goddesses in a ring looking down and inward, the center left empty for the challenger. Use normal human proportions for this illustration, not chibi.

subject.zh: 代理之战的代理战士：一名戴无面金属面盔的武者，身形挺拔，身披可以换色的长罩袍（默认素白），手持长剑与一面空白的纹章盾，肩后飘着一缕淡淡的神光。
subject.en: The proxy champion of the proxy war: a warrior in a faceless metal helm, tall and upright, a long tabard that can be recolored (plain white by default), a longsword and a blank heraldic shield, a faint wisp of divine light trailing behind the shoulders.

extra.zh: 画代理战士立在神庭的白石地面上，长剑斜指，罩袍随风扬起。插画用正常的人体比例，不用 Q 版。
extra.en: Show the proxy champion standing with the longsword angled down and the tabard lifting in the wind. Use normal human proportions for this illustration, not chibi.

items.notes: 代理之战的对手随路线变化，各自用本人的素材；这张只作代理之战的登场与图鉴插画。罩袍颜色由界面按所代表的女神换色，盾面保持空白。

subject.zh: 巨大的银色原龙，体长数十米，鳞片像磨旧的镜面，映出周围的天空（#c8d4dc、#f6fafc、#7aa0c4），双眼是没有瞳孔的白色，像月亮，角与背脊像山岩，一侧翼膜上有一个古老的破洞。
subject.en: A colossal silver primordial dragon dozens of meters long, scales like worn mirrors reflecting the sky around her (#c8d4dc, #f6fafc, #7aa0c4), white eyes with no pupils like moons, horns and spine like mountain rock, an ancient hole torn in one wing membrane.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写白色的月亮般的眼与像山岩的角。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the white moon-like eye and the rock-like horns.

items.notes: 先出三视图，主审通过后再出动作表与插画。原龙不是可战斗的首领，按首领的分部件拆图与登场插画出图（美术方案第 9.3 节）；三视图只作参照，游戏里从不完整入画。

subject.zh: 一具冻僵的守军亡灵，比常人高半头，披着结满白霜的旧板甲与撕裂的毛皮斗篷（#9aa8b4、#5a4a3a），盔缝里两点冰蓝冷光（#9ab4d0），双手死死举着一面长方的深色橡木塔盾，铁包边，盾心是褪成灰白的光轮浮纹，一道裂缝从上缘斜劈到盾心。
subject.en: A frozen garrison revenant half a head taller than a man, in old plate crusted with white frost and a torn fur cloak (#9aa8b4, #5a4a3a), two points of ice-blue cold light in the slit of its helm (#9ab4d0), both hands locked around a tall rectangular dark oak tower shield with an iron rim, a gray-white faded halo relief at its heart and a crack running slantwise from the top edge to the center.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写塔盾的灰白光轮浮纹与斜劈的裂缝。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the faded gray-white halo relief and the slanting crack on the tower shield.

subject.zh: 高约 1.6 米的一道瓷白人影，左右完全对称，没有脸，身形像一件空心长袍（#ede8dc、#d8c27a），双臂向两侧平举，下半身散成一缕不透明的白雾，身上布满对称的淡蓝细裂纹（#9db4c8），头后悬着一圈极细的几何光环。
subject.en: A porcelain-white figure about 1.6 m tall, perfectly symmetrical and faceless, shaped like a hollow robe (#ede8dc, #d8c27a), both arms held straight out to the sides, its lower half trailing into an opaque wisp of white mist, its body covered in symmetrical fine pale blue cracks (#9db4c8), a hair-thin geometric ring floating behind its head.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写对称的淡蓝细裂纹与头后的几何细环。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the symmetrical pale blue cracks and the thin geometric ring behind its head.

subject.zh: 约三米高的一座灰白油泥丘，表面像冷却的油脂（#b9b4a8、#6e6a62），泥里半埋着几十枚烧尽的灰色灯石晶壳，最深处几枚还透着暗黄残光（#c8a860），顶上斜插着几根扭弯的铁灯柱像一顶歪冠，正面一张下垂的宽口不停淌泥。
subject.en: A mound of gray-white oily sludge about three meters high, its surface like cooled grease (#b9b4a8, #6e6a62), dozens of burnt-out gray lampstone shells half buried in it, a few deep inside still glowing a dim yellow (#c8a860), several twisted iron lamp posts thrust slantwise from its top like a crooked crown, a wide drooping mouth in front that never stops dripping mud.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写半埋的灯石晶壳与顶上扭弯的铁灯柱。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the half-buried lampstone shells and the twisted iron lamp posts on top.

subject.zh: 悬在半空的一颗乳白多面晶核，约一米半高（#ede8dc），表面布满左右对称的淡蓝裂纹（#9db4c8），外面箍着一座完全对称的笼架，由骨片与镀淡金的托架（#d8c27a）交错拼成，笼架下垂着几只小小的白瓷骨匣，随它一起缓缓转动。
subject.en: A milky-white faceted crystal core about one and a half meters high hanging in midair (#ede8dc), its surface covered in mirror-symmetrical pale blue cracks (#9db4c8), clasped in a perfectly symmetrical cage of bone slats and pale-gilded brackets (#d8c27a), a few small white porcelain ossuary boxes hanging beneath the cage and turning slowly with it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写对称的淡蓝裂纹与骨片托架交错的笼架。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the symmetrical pale blue cracks and the cage of interlaced bone slats and brackets.

subject.zh: 约三米高的一座活金库，铁灰箱体（#5a5e64）包着发绿的黄铜角（#8a7a3a），正面整扇库门就是嘴，门缝一圈钱币磨成的金牙（#c9a227），门上的大锁孔是一只独眼，箱底伸出四条矮粗的铁足，身侧垂着断开的契约链与封蜡。
subject.en: A living strongroom about three meters tall, an iron-gray body (#5a5e64) with greening brass corners (#8a7a3a), its whole front vault door a mouth lined with gold teeth ground from coins (#c9a227), the great keyhole on the door a single eye, four short thick iron feet beneath, broken contract chains and wax seals hanging at its sides.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写锁孔独眼与钱币磨成的金牙。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the keyhole eye and the teeth ground from coins.

subject.zh: 约三米高的一团翻卷的旧纸页，泛黄的羊皮纸色（#d8d2c0），纸页绕着一根空心的书脊状脊骨层层旋转，每页上是看不清的灰黑墨行（#2b2b3a）与淡紫细划痕（#7a6a9a），正中最大的一页像一张没有五官的脸，边缘不停滴墨。
subject.en: A churning mass of old pages about three meters tall in yellowed parchment (#d8d2c0), the pages wheeling in layers around a hollow spine shaped like a book's back, every page covered in illegible gray-black lines of ink (#2b2b3a) and fine pale violet scratches (#7a6a9a), the largest page in the middle like a featureless face, ink dripping from its edges.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写正中那张无脸的大页与绕着书脊旋转的纸页。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the faceless great page and the pages wheeling around the spine.

subject.zh: 约三米高的亡兵之首，由几具穿着不同年代军服的尸骸熔成一个高大人形（#6a5a48、#8a4a30），甲片层层错叠，胸前挂一面破军鼓，一手扛着残破的军旗杆，杆顶插着一顶凹盔，身上几道赤黑的长裂伤口（#5a1a16）始终不合。
subject.en: The head of a dead column about three meters tall, a towering humanoid fused from several corpses in uniforms of different eras (#6a5a48, #8a4a30), armor plates overlapping in layers, a broken war drum hung on its chest, a ragged standard pole on one shoulder with a dented helm stuck on its tip, several long red-black gashes (#5a1a16) on its body that never close.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写胸前的破军鼓与杆顶的凹盔。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up of the broken war drum on its chest and the dented helm on the pole.
